name: Wi-Fi state
plain: Lets the app see Wi-Fi status; the network name needs location permission.
meaning: SSID and BSSID can place a person at home or work. Android 8.1 and later hide them without location permission.

android.prompt_ui: None for state; location prompt for SSID
android.note: Android 8.1 (API 27) requires location for SSID; Android 13 allows NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES for scan results.

ios.note: SSID needs entitlement and location grant on iOS 13+.

limits.headline: Can see if Wi-Fi is on, and its name only with location access
limits.user_action: Nothing for on or off. You tap Allow Location for the Wi-Fi name
can: See the network name after Location is allowed (Android 8.1 and newer)
Use Nearby devices permission for scan results on Android 13 and newer
cannot: See the Wi-Fi name on Android without Location
See the name on iPhone without the Apple entitlement plus Location
Switch Wi-Fi on or off for you on newer versions
limits.differs: Android 8.1 and newer needs Location for the name. iPhone 13 and newer needs an entitlement plus location.

story.what_it_is: An app can see if Wi-Fi is on or off and if you are connected.

marketing.name: Wi-Fi state
marketing.pitch: Android lets apps check Wi-Fi status with a normal permission.

story.for_you: You do not see it. An app may say 'turn on Wi-Fi to download'. The network name stays hidden unless you allow location.
story.for_makers: Makers use it to guide you and to choose downloads or sync. It is a low risk signal and adds a little to a profile. The name and ID are the sensitive parts and need location permission.

use_cases.example: A podcast app waits until Wi-Fi is on before it downloads new episodes.
A game suggests turning on Wi-Fi before a big patch download.
A smart device app asks you to turn on Wi-Fi before setup.
A backup app only uploads photos when Wi-Fi is connected.
A tracker records Wi-Fi on or off times to learn when you are home.
A battery app tells you that Wi-Fi scanning drains power.

story.android_note: Android apps see Wi-Fi status with a normal permission, and the network name needs location permission.
story.ios_note: iPhone apps can see whether the connection is Wi-Fi but not read the setting directly.

technical_bounds: Both OSes gate SSID behind location

history.change: SSID access requires location plus entitlement
